contextRow.Name: Switch Journal
contextRow.Description: Switches the journal file at midnight every day

method.turn: POST /api/ocupilot/conversation, then POST /api/ocupilot/turn {message, conversationId[, context]} as _SYSTEM, polled on /turn/:id/progress until terminal
method.stub: OcuPilot.Test.TurnWireFixture.EnsureDefinition(tag) (turnprobe, default marker), OcuPilot.Test.TurnProvider.Plain(tag), first call read with OcuPilot.Test.TurnProvider.Recorded(tag, 1, "system"|"messages"|"tools")
method.render: OcuPilot.Kernel.Provider.{Anthropic,OpenAI,Gemini}.CallMessages(%Net.HttpRequest, .values, .messages, .tools, system) on a fresh adapter (Streaming 0), values model=claude-haiku-5-5 maxTokens=32000; messages and tools rebuilt from the recorded call (role/content or blocks with the tail cache_control removed; name/description/inputSchema, start = not defer_loading, scoped when any tool is deferred). OpenAI goes through MessageAdapter.CanonicalToOpenAi and ToolDefAdapter.ToOpenAi, Gemini through MessageAdapter.CanonicalToGemini and ToolDefAdapter.ToGemini
method.chars: bodyChars = $Length of the UTF-8-decoded entity body; bodyBytes = its UTF-8 bytes; toolsChars = $Length(body.tools.%ToJSON()); tools = Anthropic and OpenAI tools.%Size(), Gemini tools[0].functionDeclarations.%Size()
method.countTokens: POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages/count_tokens, anthropic-version 2023-06-01, {model: claude-haiku-5-5, system, messages, tools} of the rendered Anthropic body (max_tokens dropped)

proxies.tasksScheduleReadDescription: Read the rows of the Task schedule screen (tasks.schedule), one scheduled task per row, bounded and with secret fields removed. Every Task Manager task, with Suspended true for a suspended one; a task's runs and their errors are in tasks.history, and portal jobs such as a database compact in tasks.background. Fields: Name, Type, Namespace, Description, Id, LastFinished, NextScheduled, Suspended.
